statement: In the diagonal-minus-correlated-projector family W=t*sum_i[e_ii]+sum_(i!=j)d_ij[e_ij]-kappa[omega] of frontier-20261028-matching-symmetric-witness-nogo-v1.json SHA256 374dab4d2e706a2bc5b037958b4c4b60763d58d303f9fe62e9694a26f2a7b765, remove ALL complementary-pair or cyclic constraints. For kappa>0 and 2kappa<=t<=(1+sqrt(3))*kappa, every 2-block-positive W is decomposable for arbitrary nonnegative real d_ij. For kappa=0 or t>=4kappa, 2-block-positive W is PSD. In the remaining parameter interval the proof does not classify arbitrary d_ij.
rank_two_test: Fix ordered i!=k and select any j outside {i,k}. Set D=t/kappa-1, and consider the rank-two matrix X made of the rank-one (i,k) block [[1,u],[1/u,1]] and a singleton X_jj=2/D; all other entries vanish. Its expectation is t*(2+4/D^2)-kappa*(2+2/D)^2 + d_ik*u^2+d_ki/u^2. Infimizing u>0 gives 2sqrt(d_ik*d_ki)+2kappa*(D-1-2/D). Therefore 2-block positivity forces q_ik=sqrt(d_ik*d_ki)>=kappa*(1-D+2/D) for every pair, including limiting cases. The prior elementary test gives t>=2kappa, so D>=1 and no division by zero occurs.
comparison_and_decomposition: Put delta=4kappa-t=kappa*(3-D) and c=delta/3. If 1<=D<=sqrt(3), then kappa*(1-D+2/D)-c=(2kappa/(3D))*(3-D^2)>=0; hence every q_ik>=c>0. Let B be the direct sum over pairs (i,k), on (e_ik,e_ki), of (c/q_ik)*[[d_ik,-q_ik],[-q_ik,d_ki]], and A=W-B^Gamma. Each block of B is PSD; A's off-diagonal-basis diagonal entries are d_ik*(1-c/q_ik)>=0. On the four diagonal basis vectors A has diagonal t-kappa and offdiagonal c-kappa, giving one eigenvalue t-4kappa+3c=0 and three eigenvalues t-c>=0. Thus W=A+B^Gamma. More generally, this same decomposition is sufficient at any 2kappa<=t<4kappa whenever the actual coefficients satisfy min_ik q_ik >= (4kappa-t)/3, regardless of whether W is 2-block positive.
exactness: The argument uses only all-parameter real algebra, exact rank-two test matrices and elementary PSD blocks; no numerical computation, external import or claimed novelty. The example checker in the predecessor checks a separate parameter point, not this analytic bound.
limits: The interval (1+sqrt(3))*kappa < t < 4kappa with some q below (4kappa-t)/3 remains unclassified here unless the matching-symmetry theorem applies. No claim about arbitrary 2-block-positive 4x4 witnesses or the existence/nonexistence of PPT/SN3 states. WRITTEN, unreviewed.
